file_change.purpose: Provide explicit non-circular acceptance, provenance, governed state advancement, and authority boundaries.
implementation: Define governed artifact identities and acceptance records for Design readiness, Planning acceptance, and Build acceptance.
Require acceptance records to identify subject, actor, decision, predecessor authority, evidence references, and resulting state without deriving authority from incidental Git/platform events.
Reject acceptance prerequisites that depend on authority created only by the candidate acceptance itself.

Record lineage from functional-set Design inputs through Planning normative requirements, accepted Plan revision, Build mutation manifest, Conformance evidence, Assurance evidence, and accepted implementation state.
Enforce keystone separation: Governance consumes Conformance and Assurance evidence but does not perform their judgments.
Advance accepted implementation state only on explicit Build acceptance.
Represent explicit rejection records preserving candidate identity, rejection reason, and provenance; rejection never promotes state.
Represent governed state and authorization scope explicitly and apply default-deny when no accepted authority or governed extension point resolves.
Resolve keystone delegation through explicit accepted authority relationships before permitting governed actions.
Maintain stable identities for Design revisions, Planning work, accepted Plans, Build work, and Build results.
Maintain normative lifecycle history for creation, amendment, supersession, and withdrawal without identity reuse.
Reference durable Conformance reports, Assurance reports, and Build mutation manifests in acceptance lineage.
